DHAKA, Jan 14, 2023 (BSS) - Bangladesh Bank (BB) will announce its Monetary Policy Statement (MPS) tomorrow (Sunday) for the second half of the financial year 2022-23 (FY23).

BB Governor Abdur Rouf Talukder will formally announce the MPS at a press conference at the central bank headquarters in the capital, a press release said here today.
